question: List Head and Neck Nivolumab trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This query lists Head and Neck cancer trials using Nivolumab with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"cancer_type\", \"ici_class\", \"trial_phase\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Head and Neck%' AND \"ici_name\" = 'Nivolumab' AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21",
  "answer": "This query lists Head and Neck cancer trials using Nivolumab with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
